fix_description: Update backend CORS middleware allow_origins list to include the new frontend domain. Ensure both http and https variants are listed. Restart the server after applying changes.
common_mistakes: Forgetting trailing slash in origin URL
Not restarting server after config change
resolution_steps: Identify the blocked origin from browser console
Add origin to CORS allow_origins array
Verify allow_methods includes required HTTP methods
Test with browser DevTools network tab

fix_description: Increase connection pool size and configure idle timeout. Add connection retry logic with exponential backoff. Monitor active connections with pg_stat_activity.
common_mistakes: Setting pool size too high for available server RAM
Missing connection cleanup in error handlers
resolution_steps: Add health check ping to pool

fix_description: Implement refresh token rotation pattern. Store refresh tokens server-side. Add automatic silent renewal before access token expiry. Handle expired token gracefully on frontend.
common_mistakes: Storing tokens in localStorage (use httpOnly cookies)
resolution_steps: Add token rotation on each refresh
Set up automatic silent renewal on frontend
Add token blacklist for revoked tokens

fix_description: Run security audit on all dependencies. Update affected packages to patched versions. Test for breaking changes after update. Deploy hotfix to production.
common_mistakes: Not running full test suite after patching
resolution_steps: Run npm audit / pip-audit to identify CVEs
Check CVE severity and exploit details

fix_description: Profile application memory usage to identify leak source. Common causes: unclosed database connections, event listener accumulation, large object caching without eviction, circular references.
common_mistakes: Using global mutable state without cleanup
Not disposing event listeners on component unmount

fix_description: Verify webhook signature validation. Ensure idempotent processing of payment events. Handle all relevant event types (payment_intent.succeeded, customer.subscription.updated, etc).
common_mistakes: Missing error handling for partial failures
resolution_steps: Verify webhook endpoint URL in Stripe dashboard
Add logging for all webhook events
Test with Stripe CLI webhook forwarding

fix_description: Renew SSL certificate through certificate authority or auto-renewal service. Update certificate files on server. Configure automatic renewal with certbot or similar tool.
common_mistakes: Not setting up auto-renewal cron job
Wrong file permissions on certificate files
resolution_steps: Renew via certbot or CA portal

fix_description: Replace raw SQL string concatenation with parameterized queries. Use ORM query builders where possible. Add input validation and sanitization at API layer.
resolution_steps: Add SQLAlchemy ORM layer where possible
Run sqlmap scan to verify fix
Add WAF rules as extra protection

fix_description: Implement heartbeat/ping-pong mechanism. Add automatic reconnection with exponential backoff on client. Configure proxy timeout settings to keep connections alive.
common_mistakes: Proxy timeout shorter than heartbeat interval
Not handling reconnection state on frontend
resolution_steps: Add connection state indicator in UI

fix_description: Identify circular redirect conditions in authentication flow. Add redirect loop detection with max redirect count. Fix conditional logic that creates circular auth checks.
common_mistakes: Auth middleware checking auth on the login page itself
Cookie domain mismatch between redirect targets
resolution_steps: Add public route exclusions to auth middleware

fix_description: Replace OFFSET-based pagination with keyset (cursor) pagination for consistent performance on large datasets. Add proper indexes on sort columns.
common_mistakes: Not adding index on cursor column
Missing ORDER BY consistency with cursor
resolution_steps: Identify slow paginated queries with EXPLAIN
Add index on id/created_at cursor column
Encode cursor as base64 for API
Update frontend to pass cursor instead of page number

fix_description: Implement CSS custom property based theming. Store user preference in localStorage. Respect system prefers-color-scheme. Add smooth transition between themes.
common_mistakes: Flash of wrong theme on page load (FOUC)
Missing system preference media query fallback
resolution_steps: Define light and dark CSS variable sets
Load theme before first paint (inline script)

fix_description: Use HTML5 Drag and Drop API or react-beautiful-dnd library. Handle state reordering on drop. Persist new order to backend API. Add visual drop zone indicators.
common_mistakes: Race condition on rapid reorder API calls
resolution_steps: Install dnd library or implement native API
Add draggable attribute and event handlers
Implement optimistic state reorder on drop
POST new order to backend API
Add visual drag indicators and drop zones

fix_description: Restart Redis queue consumer worker. Check for dead letter queue messages. Implement retry logic with exponential backoff for failed sends.
common_mistakes: Worker process silently dying without restart
No dead letter queue for failed messages
resolution_steps: Inspect failed messages in dead letter queue
Add worker health monitoring and auto-restart
Add retry logic with max attempts

fix_description: Review and correct S3 bucket policy and ACL settings. Ensure public-read for public assets. Use signed URLs for private files. Check CORS configuration on bucket.
common_mistakes: Block Public Access enabled when public files needed
Missing CORS configuration on S3 bucket
Using bucket-level ACL instead of object-level
resolution_steps: Check current bucket policy in AWS console
Update bucket policy for correct access
Configure S3 CORS for frontend domain
Use CloudFront for better caching and security

fix_description: Run spellcheck across all documentation files. Update outdated code examples. Verify all links are not broken. Ensure consistent formatting.
common_mistakes: Broken relative links after file moves
resolution_steps: Check all links with link checker tool
Update code examples to match current API

fix_description: Identify and fix CSS layout issues. Use CSS Grid or Flexbox for responsive layouts. Ensure consistent spacing using design tokens. Test across breakpoints.
common_mistakes: Using fixed pixel widths instead of responsive units
resolution_steps: Identify the layout issue in browser DevTools
Check computed styles and box model
Fix using CSS custom properties for consistency
Test across mobile, tablet, desktop breakpoints
Verify no visual regressions on other pages

fix_description: Set up or fix automated test suite. Configure test runner. Write unit tests for critical paths. Add integration tests for API endpoints.
common_mistakes: Missing test database cleanup between runs
resolution_steps: Write tests for critical user flows

fix_description: Review rate limiting rules. Whitelist internal service IPs. Implement different rate tiers for authenticated vs anonymous users. Add rate limit headers to responses.
common_mistakes: Same rate limit for all endpoints
resolution_steps: Add IP whitelist for internal services
Implement tiered limits by auth status

fix_description: Monitor replication lag metrics. Reduce write-heavy operations during peak. Configure read-after-write consistency for critical queries. Add lag threshold alerting.
common_mistakes: Reading from replica immediately after write
resolution_steps: Consider synchronous replication for critical data
